description: Level 3 Stage 0 (groundwork, no behaviour change): before/after comparison on branch level3. Before = level2 tip 958a56d; after = the Stage 0 changes. Both on the dev server (vite :5173), Claude desktop app built-in Chromium, hidden pane, AMD Radeon integrated GPU.
changes: world.js: per-level bounds (world.bounds / setBounds, default LAYOUT.bounds); optional rng argument for _frontage/_building (default: the boulevard stream); rear-cordon gate (four centre barriers) in its own batch, opened by setCordonGate, whose colliders are switched off rather than removed; quietly() builds start-up objects without drawing from Math.random
events.js: BOULEVARD_EVENTS (zones, hazard and car-fire z clamps, CRS tear-gas origin) read from the level's `events`
crowd.js: BOULEVARD_LAYOUT (gather points, march paths, crew z range, bystander z, idle focus, background exclusion rects) and setLayout()
audio.js: BOULEVARD_SIREN_LANES / audio.sirenLanes; music.js: THEMES (Level 2 theme only), setTheme(), per-theme bpm overrides
boss.js: behaviour flags (pattern, keepDist, closeSpeed, intro) replace checks on the boss id
main.js: setLevel applies events config, bounds, crowd layout, siren lanes and music theme

world.note: One extra static mesh: the cordon gate's own batch (same barriers, same vertex total). A first attempt that built the gate as separate meshes during start-up shifted the seeded Math.random stream before the crowd was built (three.js draws it for every uuid) and Level 1 diverged; the gate now goes through the same _vauban path and its batch is merged inside quietly().

bosses.verdict: IDENTICAL before and after: lint clean; charge launch-to-contact 0.52 / 0.63 / 0.72 / 0.80 / 1.03 s at 4.5-9 m; wall stun pass; transitions 4/4; feints 6, all 6 real attacks after a feint safe, 0 chop hits taken; fuzz leader and enforcer pass with identical visit counts; checkpoint pass

newHooks.setCordonGate: closed: centre and side both blocked; open: centre free, sides still blocked, gate mesh hidden; closing again restores both
newHooks.setBounds: default clamps z at 182; Level 3 bounds let z = 300 through and block z = 500; null restores 182
newHooks.crowd.setLayout: partial layouts merge with the boulevard defaults; null restores them
newHooks.music.setTheme: unknown names fall back to the Level 2 theme
newHooks.events.cfg: Level 2 uses the boulevard config (hazard z -120..170, 10 zones)

build: npm run build: clean (48 modules, index 975 kB / 279 kB gzip)
